title: Aromatic Egyptian Oysters Bake
description: A garlicky, molten baked oyster dish that balances light Egyptian flavors with a rich buttery sauce, served from a fondue pot for a unique presentation.
instructions: Place the fondue pot on the stove over medium heat and melt the butter.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Stir in the grated Parmesan, lemon juice, and whisked egg white until the mixture thickens slightly.
Season the sauce with salt, pepper, and chopped parsley.
Arrange the shucked oysters in the fondue pot, placing them on top of the sauce.
Optionally sprinkle bread crumbs over the oysters for extra crispness.
Bake for 10 minutes until the oysters are cooked through and the top is golden and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 2 minutes.
Serve immediately, piping the remaining sauce over each oyster.
